tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background: warm black in dark (the default), warm paper in light. Text on it: ink, muted, accent-ink, ok, warn, info.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised areas on bg: cards, notes, menus, dialogs, the promo bar. Same text colors as bg.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover fills, pills, switch tracks, snackbars: the second ground on surface. Text on it: ink, muted, accent-ink, ok, warn, info.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-2; 14:1 or better.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, nav links, captions, lead paragraphs on bg, surface and surface-2; at least 5.6:1. Light value is derived.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between sections, under the masthead and around cards. Decorative only. Light value is derived.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outline of pills, code blocks and menus. Source value, kept exact: about 1.7:1 on bg, so it never marks an input, switch or checkbox (use border-control). Light value is derived.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of text fields, switches and any control whose edge must be seen; at least 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-2 in both themes. Added to close a gap in the source.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one accent: Android green. FILL for the primary action, copied state, step badges, switch tracks, focus outlines. Text on it: on-accent (10.5:1). Same in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of accent fills. Light value is derived.

tokens.name: accent-quiet
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind step numbers and selected chips. Light value is derived.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent-colored TEXT and links on bg, surface and surface-2; 4.5:1 or better in both themes. Light value is derived.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent fills, both themes.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Background of code and prompt blocks. Text in them: ink, code-muted. Light value is derived.

tokens.name: code-muted
tokens.usage: Labels and comments inside code blocks on code-bg; at least 4.9:1. Light value is derived.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success text or marks on bg and surface-2, always with a word or check icon. Light value is derived.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning, error and destructive text or marks on bg and surface-2, always with a word or icon, never color alone. Light value is derived.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices (not alarms) as text or a small mark on bg and surface-2, with a word or icon. Blue keeps it apart from ok and warn for red-green color blindness. Added; both values derived.

tokens.name: partner-cyan
tokens.usage: Cross-promo icon stroke only (the terminal glyph in the promo bar), never text and never a fill. Source value, kept exact; it carries meaning through the adjacent label, not its color.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Full-screen layer behind a dialog. Added; derived.

tokens.name: disabled-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons of a disabled control (38%, the Material 3 disabled-content level). Exempt from contrast by WCAG but always paired with a visible disabled shape. Added.

tokens.name: disabled-fill
tokens.usage: Container of a disabled control (12%, the Material 3 disabled-container level). Added.

tokens.name: selection
tokens.usage: ::selection background. Source value in dark; light is derived.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 2px keyboard focus outline, offset 3px, on every interactive element; 3:1 or better on bg, surface and surface-2.

groups.name: UI
groups.note: Geist has 400, 500 and 600 loaded only, so bold headings render at 600. Fluid sizes: display 36-60px, h2 26-36px, via clamp with viewport units.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero title, one per page; fluid from 36px on phones. Balance the wrap.

styles.name: lead
styles.usage: Intro paragraph under the hero, in muted, at most 66ch.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text, at most 66ch. Note titles use it at weight 600.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Nav links, notes, captions, field hints and footer text, in muted.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, copy buttons and field labels.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code and prompt blocks, tab size 2, always left-to-right.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Footer meta line with tabular numerals.

groups.name: Social image
groups.note: 1200x630 preview image. Headline size drops per language (82px Latin down to 66px Japanese); tracking normal for Arabic and CJK.

styles.name: og-title
styles.usage: Social image headline, with the subject phrase in accent.

styles.name: og-sub
styles.usage: Social image subline in muted, at most 30ch.

spacing.note: Values are the ones the source uses; the 4px grid holds except the 7px menu-row radius.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps, tight inline spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between pill buttons; chip and switch inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap in notes and code bars; heading to text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Paragraph gap, note padding, default stack gap.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Minimum page gutter; pill button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section head to its content; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Minimum section padding (section padding runs 44px to 72px fluid).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Maximum section padding.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Maximum hero top padding (runs 56px to 104px fluid).

radius.note: Custom shape scale, not Material 3's. See android.md for the mapping.

tokens.name: radius-2xs
tokens.usage: Focus outline corners, skip-link corner.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Rows inside a menu.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Notes, code blocks, menus, text fields, snackbars.

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: Boxes: cards, panels, dialogs, color blocks.

tokens.name: pill
tokens.usage: Every button, chip, toggle, badge and address pill.

size.note: Fixed dimensions. Widths that depend on the viewport (gutter, section padding) are clamp() values described in layout-and-languages.md.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch or pointer target in either direction, per Android guidance. Icon buttons and nav links are padded up to it; the source's bare 19px nav icons were not.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small pill buttons (related-project links, promo actions, close button).

tokens.name: masthead-h
tokens.usage: Minimum masthead height.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Page column width.

tokens.name: code-max-h
tokens.usage: Scroll height of the prompt block.

tokens.name: menu-min-w
tokens.usage: Language menu minimum width.

tokens.name: menu-max-h
tokens.usage: Language menu maximum height (or 68vh, whichever is smaller).

tokens.name: step-badge
tokens.usage: Diameter of the numbered step badge.

tokens.name: switch-w
tokens.usage: Switch track width.

tokens.name: switch-h
tokens.usage: Switch track height.

tokens.name: icon-globe
tokens.usage: Language menu globe icon.

tokens.name: icon-promo
tokens.usage: Promo bar and close icons.

tokens.name: icon-social
tokens.usage: Footer social icons.

tokens.name: icon-nav
tokens.usage: Masthead nav icons.

tokens.name: mark-w
tokens.usage: Wordmark glyph width.

tokens.name: mark-h
tokens.usage: Wordmark glyph height.

tokens.name: og-w
tokens.usage: Social image width.

tokens.name: og-h
tokens.usage: Social image height.

shadow.note: Depth is flat. Only floating layers get a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-menu
tokens.usage: Language menu and other popovers. Dark value is the source; light is derived.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs. Added; derived from shadow-menu.

opacity.note: Material 3 state layers and disabled levels, laid over the control's own color.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: Hover layer on a control.

tokens.name: state-focus
tokens.usage: Focus layer (with the focus ring).

tokens.name: state-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed layer.

tokens.name: state-dragged
tokens.usage: Dragged layer.

tokens.name: content-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled text and icons.

tokens.name: container-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled container.

tokens.name: grain
tokens.usage: Fixed film-grain overlay; source value.

duration.note: Source values plus the Material 3 short and medium steps they sit between.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback (Material 3 short2). Added.

tokens.name: dur-copy
tokens.usage: Copy button state change. Source.

tokens.name: dur-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and menu caret. Source (Material 3 short4).

tokens.name: dur-close
tokens.usage: Close button color. Source (Material 3 medium1).

tokens.name: dur-medium
tokens.usage: Dialog and snackbar entrance. Added (Material 3 medium2).

tokens.name: dur-fade
tokens.usage: Promo bar opacity. Source.

tokens.name: dur-expand
tokens.usage: Promo bar height. Source (Material 3 long2).

easing.note: ease-out is the source default; the others are the Material 3 curves for Android parity.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Default for every transition. Source.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Utility motion that starts and ends on screen. Material 3 standard.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Elements entering the screen (dialogs, snackbars). Material 3 emphasized decelerate.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Elements leaving the screen. Material 3 emphasized accelerate.

tokens.name: z-masthead
tokens.usage: Sticky masthead.

tokens.name: z-menu
tokens.usage: Language menu.

tokens.name: z-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialog and its scrim.

tokens.name: z-snackbar
tokens.usage: Snackbar.

tokens.name: z-grain
tokens.usage: Film-grain overlay.

tokens.name: z-skip
tokens.usage: Skip link.
